{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bureau of Revenue''' was part of the [[Algarian Bureaucracy]]. All other Bureaus reported to the Bureau of Revenue, which collected taxes and allocated funds. The Bureau was comprised of one member from each of the other Bureaus that made up the government.
